approved: Private Health Insurance (National Joint Replacement Register Levy) Amendment Bill 2025

Moved the Private Health Insurance (National Joint Replacement Register Levy) Amendment Bill 2025, allowing rules to identify the person responsible for the levy over time and validating past levy collections.

Supported the Private Health Insurance (National Joint Replacement Register Levy) Amendment Bill 2025, saying it would clarify levy responsibility and validate past collections so the registry could continue collecting and analysing joint-replacement data; also criticised hospital funding and aged-care delivery, including delays in releasing home-care packages.
Asked that the second reading amendment moved by Senator Ruston to the Private Health Insurance (National Joint Replacement Register Levy) Amendment Bill 2025 be agreed to.
